name: Teen Team Volunteers
org: Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum
what_you_do: Help museum staff run hands-on programs and greet guests. You take about one assignment a month, mostly on weekends.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17 or high school freshmen to seniors. You must pass a background check, which the museum pays for. No experience needed.
deadline_text: The join page says the museum is not accepting new volunteer applications as of Nov 4, 2026. It says new chances come later this year, with no date. The Teen Team page still shows Apply Today.
how_to_apply: Check the join page for new dates. When it opens again, send an application and a short resume, then interview. Email volunteer@countrymusichalloffame.org with questions.
notes: The museum also runs a Songwriting Camp for ages 12 to 18 (June 14 to 19 and July 12 to 17, 2027). 2027 fees are $535 for members and $625 for non-members, with need based aid.
